articles.headline: Durant scores 22, Sheppard hits five 3-pointers to lead Rockets to a win in Atlanta's home opener
articles.description: — Kevin Durant scored 22 points and both Reed Sheppard and Tari Eason had 19 points as the Houston Rockets beat the Atlanta Hawks 121-114.

articles.description: — Victor Wembanyama had 23 points, seven rebounds and four blocks, Dylan Harper scored 22 points and the San Antonio Spurs beat the Dallas Mavericks 122-106 on Saturday night for their first victory of the season.

articles.headline: Cavaliers survive a late Nets rally to win home opener 125-121
articles.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 22 points, Jarrett Allen added 21 points, and the Cleveland Cavaliers won their home opener, 125-121 over the Brooklyn Nets on Saturday night.
